# Fraeno

Fraeno is a security gate between a software update and a robot. It manages
robot software dependencies and validates every update against a live launch
of the robot's ROS 2 system before the change can merge.

- Product site: https://fraeno.com/
- What it does: discovers dependencies across ROS 2, Python, CMake, Docker,
  APT, vcstool, and git submodules; changes one dependency at a time; builds
  baseline and candidate environments; compares nodes, topics, services,
  actions, QoS, rates, transforms, and diagnostics; blocks the pull request
  when behavior regresses.
- Supported target: ROS 2 Humble on Ubuntu 22.04, amd64 and arm64, through a
  GitHub App and Docker-based GitHub Actions runner.
- Request access: use the contact form at https://fraeno.com/
- Company: DeepUbuntu Labs (https://deepubuntu.com/)
